units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 40:17">Targ. Job XL, 17</cite> (ed. Lag. <cite ref="K01044"><he>כפיף</he></cite>, ed. Wil. <he>כפף</he>, Ms. <cite ref="K00016"><he>כאיף</he></cite>; h. text <he>יחפץ</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 34:11">Targ. Ps. XXXIV, 11</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 41:55">Targ. Gen. XLI, 55</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 62b:2">Ber. 62ᵇ</cite> (prov.) <he>עד דכַפְנַת אכול</he> eat while thou art hungry (delay nothing).
Pes. 107ᵇ bot. כי היכי דאגיר׳ ואִכְפַן אמצה וכ׳ Ms. M. (read: דאיגרר, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note; ed. דניגרריה לליביה) that I may get an appetite and be eager for the Matsah in the evening.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 83a:10">B. Mets. 83ᵃ</cite> <he>וכְפִינָן</he> and we are hungry; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 2:2">Esth. R. to I, 4</cite> <he>כַּפְנָאִי</he> I am hungry (?).]
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 8:3">Targ. Deut. VIII, 3</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 33a:12">Sabb. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>מַכְפֵּין נפשיה</he> he starved himself (and grew sick in consequence).
